value_or_angle: header="New Hampshire's first highway engineer" body="When New Hampshire formed its State Highway Department in 1905, John was put in charge of its roads and bridges as state engineer. In 1903 he had been secretary of the Good Roads League under the former governor Frank W. Rollins." category=career

value_or_angle: header="The arch above Quechee Gorge" body="John designed the steel deck arch that carried the Woodstock Railway across Vermont's Quechee Gorge in 1911, 160 feet above the Ottauquechee. When the line folded in 1933 it was decked over for US Route 4, and it still carries the road." category=career
status: OK nb_approved appended verbatim: 'The arch above Quechee Gorge'

value_or_angle: header="Deaf from scarlet fever, an engineer anyway" body="Scarlet fever in childhood left John with poor eyesight and almost no hearing. He qualified as an engineer all the same, in 1885, the year he married Carrie Dow of Concord." category=character
